title: Premium Academy: clearer learning priority and connected screen states
summary: Refine the existing Signature redesign against the full brief: responsive dashboard composition, actionable empty states, completion milestones and themed practice surfaces.

changes.detail: Prioritize resume immediately alongside/below the hero, adapt desktop/tablet composition and localize weekday labels. Notification shortcut opens notification preferences.
Reusable empty-state actions, collection recovery links, missing-path recovery and a real completion milestone for all published path lessons.
Suppress misleading empty bookmarks when saved code exists, translate French clear-search label and react to reduced-motion setting changes.
Replace independent curriculum, speaking and coding challenge palettes with shared semantic theme tokens; retain readable dark code surfaces.

validation.name: Source and previous visual audit
validation.detail: Inventoried all 47 app route/layout files and shared/custom surfaces in artifacts/signature/brief-screen-audit.json; reviewed existing Signature documentation and saved Arabic 320px/English desktop renders.

validation.name: Fresh regression and browser validation
validation.detail: Pending typecheck, lint, tests, export and expanded three-language/two-theme route matrix. Physical-device performance and keyboard behavior are not established by browser checks. No deployment.
